citations.claim: Muay Thai is built around eight points of contact and is known as the art of eight limbs.
IFMA (International Federation of Muaythai Amateur) was inaugurated in 1993 and is the governing body of amateur Muay Thai, with 128 member countries, recognized by the Olympic Council of Asia.
The term kickboxing originated in Japan in the 1960s, developing in the late 1950s out of karate mixed with boxing.
American kickboxing originated in the United States, created in the 1970s.
Dutch kickboxing incorporates four combat arts: Japanese kickboxing, Muay Thai, boxing, and Kyokushin karate.

Under WAKO's published rulesets, elbows are forbidden in full contact, low kick, and K1-style disciplines; clinch fighting is forbidden outright in full contact and low kick, and capped under five seconds in K1-style.
citations.source: Wikipedia, World Association of Kickboxing Organizations
